Let each species start at N. A 2,700% increase makes the prey N + 27N = 28N, and a 180% increase makes the predators N + 1.8N = 2.8N. The prey exceed the predators by 28N − 2.8N = 25.2N, which is 25.2N/2.8N = 9 = 900% of the predators. A common mistake is using 27 and 1.8 as the final amounts instead of adding the original N.
